active_continuity: Lee Jungryong restored Go Jun by channeling mana into him after Taekyung defeated him.
Go Jun reports that Taekyung's strength and speed exceeded his own and that Taekyung has extensive combat experience.
Lee Jungryong is certain that Taekyung learned a mana cultivation method; how Taekyung obtained it is unknown.
Team Leader Choi and Kim Hwajong did not learn a mana cultivation method.
Ares Guild's security team has been taught mana cultivation methods and is absolutely loyal to Lee Jungryong.
Lee Jungryong regards Cheon Taemin as an older brother despite no blood relation and has respected and feared him since meeting him at age thirty.
Cheon Taemin must not be mentioned casually in Lee Jungryong's presence; Go Jun was reprimanded for invoking him.
Lee Jungryong ordered expanded surveillance of the Peace Guild, assessment of its useful personnel, security-team reinforcement, and monitoring of Ares executives and overseas branches.
Team Leader Choi's overseas transfers, surveillance, and difficulty recruiting for the Peace Guild resulted from Lee Jungryong's pressure.
Taekyung rejected Choi's proposed contract termination and promised to make the Peace Guild stronger.
open_questions: Who taught Jin Taekyung the mana cultivation method?
What history led Lee Jungryong to regard the unrelated Cheon Taemin as his older brother?
temporary_decisions: Render 마나 연공법 as "mana cultivation method."
Render 형님 as "older brother" in Lee Jungryong's internal address to Cheon Taemin while preserving the chosen-kinship context.
